Trust gap, trajectory and the real shift

takeaways: Phi-4 and MAI-1 are not rivals: the small, local Phi-4 models execute fast as the runtime while the cloud-hosted MAI-1 handles deep, multi-step reasoning.
The real engineering work is the routing layer that classifies each request and sends routine work to a small model and only hard problems to the frontier model.
Organizations need someone who owns workload classification and governance decisions, and should build verification into AI workflows while legal disclaimers still lag behind the technology.
hook: Asking whether MAI-1 or Phi-4 is the better model is the wrong question for enterprise AI. This episode is for M365 architects, admins and budget owners and explains the reason-and-runtime split, why routing and workload classification decide cost and latency, and what governance gaps remain.
